asset_heavy.reason: Owns a large railcar lease fleet plus manufacturing plants; fleet growth requires heavy ongoing capital investment.

big_ticket.reason: Railcars are costly, infrequent purchases or multi-year leases for shippers and lessors; maintenance is a smaller part.

cyclical_demand.reason: Most revenue is railcar leasing, which is steadier, though new railcar manufacturing orders can be postponed in downturns.

large_customers.reason: Customers are railroads, industrial shippers, and railcar lessors and investors, mostly large enterprises.

notes: Leasing is the larger part of the business; railcar manufacturing is the other main segment. Cyclicality is a close call.

offers_products.reason: Manufactures railcars (tank, freight) sold to customers; this is a main segment alongside leasing.

offers_services.reason: Railcar leasing, fleet maintenance, repair and logistics services are main offerings.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from the railcar fleet and manufacturing plants, not mainly staff time.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most revenue comes from multi-year railcar leases, which bring ongoing rental income.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Railcars and leases go to shippers, railroads and lessors, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Leases and sells railcars to industrial shippers, railroads and financial investors.
